en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a busy European city street lined with ornate historic buildings. A tram line runs along the center of the street with pedestrians and carriages. On the right side stands a tall baroque-style church or tower with a clock, while domed and spired buildings are visible on the left. At the top left, printed in small text, it reads "Graz. Herrengasse."
